title.narrative: Humanitarian Capacity Building and Partners Accompanier Project

description.narrative:
The quality of CAFOD’s work is reflected by the quality of work done by its local partners. This project is about improving the quality and accountability of work of CAFOD strategic partners.Emphasis will be on key aspects of humanitarian work, project cycle management, effective emergency response, international humanitarian standards and administrative support systems. The level of improvement is up to where partners are confident and consistent in the use and application of international humanitarian standards and principles in their programming. Whilst some capacity exists in the partners this project seeks to strengthen the capacity of the partners to respond to emergency situations and to mitigate the impact of humanitarian disasters in their areas of operation .
Besides projects implementation, the capacity building project seeks to help partners to improve their administrative systems and procedures in areas such as human resources, finance, supply chain and logistics, parish and diocesan project implementation and administration guidelines. By aiming at improving the quality of work of partners the envisaged outcomes will be improved effectiveness in delivery of humanitarian and development work, improved accountability of partners and administrative systems.
Key areas of focus shall be on improving project cycle management, better implementation of emergency responses and improving community managed disaster risk reduction and preparedness. For example, one area of training will be on conducting needs assessments during an emergency which shall involve simulation exercises within a community on data gathering, analysis, production of a needs assessment report, production of a project proposal and planning an emergency response. Other key areas of training shall be on international humanitarian principles and humanitarian law, humanitarian standards such as Good Enough Guide, HAP-I, Sphere, LEGS (for partners that deal with pastoral communities) Red Cross Code of Conduct and so on.
